posts.name: Aditya Narthi
posts.cooked: I’m taking the System Commands course this term, and I came across BPTS for eligibility. However, I’m not sure about the deadlines for completing them, and I also don’t know the due dates for the assignments in the VM environment. How can I find out the due dates?

posts.name: Asha C V
posts.cooked:
Hi,

The first BPT has been released on 23rd of May. Please check your notifications in the course page. The deadline is today.

Screenshot 2025-05-30 at 13.30.321144×1114 150 KB

Biweekly Programming Test (BPT) Release Dates week 3, week 5, week 7, week 10

BPT dates (as per the mail from the team):

BPT 1 - Friday, May 23, 2025

BPT 2 - Friday, June 27, 2025

BPT 3 - Friday, July 11, 2025

BPT 4 - Friday, August 1, 2025.

The deadlines are given in the course calendar. Please check.

posts.name: Aditya Narthi
posts.cooked: hey can you please tell me where that announcement was sent, and my official calendar is empty it says nothing about deadlines

posts.name: Asha C V
posts.cooked:
Hi,

On your course page, top right there is a bell icon. Click that and you’ll find the notifications

Screenshot 2025-05-30 at 14.57.581920×853 116 KB

In the course calendar top side it shows BPT end date. Mostly deadlines are within about a week from the release of the BPT questions. So once you get the notification, please check that week’s and next week’s calendar.

Screenshot 2025-05-30 at 15.00.062258×510 21.5 KB

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
It is sent in course portal itself.
The calendar you should add from the about course page. It is course calendar you need to add for each course.

posts.name: Aditya Narthi
posts.cooked: thank you so much this helps alot
